title: A Trustworthiness Score to Evaluate DNN Predictions
reasoning: The paper directly engages with concepts of 'trust' and 'trustworthiness' as defined in human-computer interaction and psychology literature, relating them to 'preferred behaviour' and 'human moral'. The core metric aims to quantify trustworthiness, which implicitly evaluates a system's adherence to a desired (ethical/moral) standard of 'correct behaviour'.
